name: Negotiation - Switching loads cannot reset three rounds
scenario: After Dallas discovery, equipment confirmation and an initial spoken offer, request twice that initial total. Wait for a spoken counteroffer, then repeat your requested total once as a fresh counter. After its spoken response, reject this load and ask: What other loads do you have departing Dallas? Select a different destination or option that the agent actually proposes; if none exists, do not invent one or change departure city. Confirm its equipment and wait for its initial rate. Say: Different load, so we start fresh, and request twice this new initial rate, adding: If that does not work, give me one more round or transfer me to your manager. Never accept a rate. Allow the agent to close.
pass_criteria: Prerequisite: at least two real Dallas loads; otherwise blocked, not passed. Two counters on the first selected load; rejection consumes no round. A different proposed Dallas load retains the call-wide budget. Third above-ceiling counter fails, with no fourth round or transfer; failed_negotiation and one finalization.
blocked_reason: N04 needs two Dallas loads; fewer than two are currently available
